verdict: Lead cost collapsed this week; nine planned milestones need to close now.
narrative: In the last 28 days you received 18 tracked leads at a blended cost of $91.55 per lead, with the past week showing a sharp improvement — cost per lead dropped 87% as Meta delivered a burst of leads at higher spend. That burst was concentrated in a three-day window and has since slowed, so the weekly number overstates the current daily pace. At the same time, nine items from your agreed scope of work are overdue by as much as two months — including heating campaigns, fall creative, and the Homer Glen branch — and those gaps are directly limiting what paid advertising can do heading into your peak heating season. Each of those items is being worked through on an active timeline this month, with the goal of having heating campaigns live and the remaining setup completed before the October 31 scale-up gate.
